description: Registers a NEW evidence record in an evidence group. Requires: evidence_group_create → evidenceGroupId, case_file_create → caseFileId. Generate a UUID v4 for `id`; compute the file's SHA-256 hex hash BEFORE calling. INTERNAL (default custodyType): the response returns uploadFileUrl, a presigned S3 URL that expires. PUT the exact bytes to it with header x-amz-checksum-sha256 set to the raw SHA-256 digest in base64 (not the hex), verify with evidence_get/evidence_list, and ONLY THEN call evidence_seal. Or pass `fileUrl` (public HTTPS, no redirects, max 1 GiB) and this tool downloads and uploads the file for you. EXTERNAL registers the hash only; use it only on purpose. WARNING: {code:'EvidenceCreateError'} can come back even when the evidence WAS persisted: check evidence_list before retrying, and never reuse an id whose outcome is unknown.

custodyType.description: INTERNAL = GoCertius stores the file; EXTERNAL = only hash registered

fileUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS URL to download and auto-upload to the returned uploadFileUrl (custodyType INTERNAL only). Omit this when you want the manual presigned-URL flow.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content (64 hex chars)

id.description: UUID v4 for the new evidence record (idempotency key)

name: evidence_create
